focus: Data visualization, statistics, statistical analysis, and reproducible scientific computing
title: Duplicate Keys, Join Multiplication, and the Meaning of a Row
utility_title: CSV Visualizer: Labeled Scatter Plots and Histograms
utility_use_case: After joining instrument readings to station metadata, a researcher can export a labeled scatter plot of two numeric measurements or a histogram of one measurement to inspect distributions and possible anomalies. The JSON counts make omissions explicit. The visualization supports exploratory review; it cannot determine whether duplicated rows are errors, validate join keys, or support significance or causal claims.
